Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, awaken me during this month to the blessings of its pre-dawn hours
And illuminate my heart with the brightness of its lights

Arabic text: وَخُذْ بِكُلِّ أَعْضَاءِ إِلَى اتِّبَاعِ آثَارِهِ
Translation: And guide all my limbs to follow its traditions
By Your light, O Illuminator of the hearts of those who know You
